name: Sour Chem
summary: **Sour Chem** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]], a cross of [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]] and [[chemdawg-d|Chem D]], a cut from the [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] line.

sources.title: Sour Chem - Strain Information
sources.note: L1-C audit 2026-09-25: gives Sour Diesel x Chemdog D, also known as Chem Sour or Chemdog Sour Diesel; no breeder named.
